title: Companies (Management and Administration) Amendment Rules, 2025 — G.S.R. 358(E)

content.publisher: Ministry of Corporate Affairs / Gazette of India
content.citation: Companies (Management and Administration) Amendment Rules, 2025, G.S.R. 358(E), 30 May 2025
content.note: The Gazette identifier and notification text were located through indexed secondary reproductions. Those reproductions describe the operative amendment as substitution of Forms MGT-7, MGT-7A and MGT-15 in the Annexure, effective 14 July 2025, and state that the principal Rules were last amended by G.S.R. 403(E), 15 July 2024. The official Gazette PDF URL is recorded for primary-source retrieval, but the PDF could not be independently opened in this pass. This is limited amendment-chain evidence only: it does not verify the full current Rule 18, prove that no later Rule 18 amendment exists, or replace checking the complete official Gazette text.
